display_long_description:
Air Distribution Systems is an immersive VR training application developed by ImmerseLearn to enhance practical learning in HVAC air distribution. Designed as part of the Air Distribution Systems micro-credential program, this application enables learners to engage in realistic, scenario-based training that builds critical skills in system components, airflow management, and installation practices.

Through interactive simulations, users can explore key concepts, practice procedures, and gain confidence in a safe, controlled environment that mirrors real-world HVAC tasks. The experience is structured to reinforce theoretical knowledge through hands-on application, improving retention and job readiness.

Please note: This application is exclusively accessible to individuals enrolled in the ImmerseLearn Air Distribution Systems micro-credential program. Access is restricted and intended solely for registered learners as part of their training journey.
